headline: Exchanges Post A 2,853,843,385.4 Dollar Outflow, 1.1666 Percent Of Reserves
narrative: Crypto exchanges recorded a 24-hour net outflow of 2,853,843,385.4 dollars, equal to 1.1666 percent of reserves. That pipe is a heavy outflow, meaning coins left trading venues instead of arriving for sale. Bitcoin exchange reserves fell 18,461.6 coins over seven days to 1,248,159.22, and cumulative volume delta printed 641.633, the 97.3 percentile of its 30-day range, with buyers firmly in control, while bitcoin traded near 77k.
author: jordan
